subject: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts: KMS rotation & privileged access export (ArborPay)
messages:
From: Emma Cole <emma@arborpay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Davenport <mike.davenport@arborpay.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts for our audit

Hi Markus,

We're starting our vendor audit for Q4 and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the period that covers Oct 1, 2025 through Sep 30, 2026. In addition to the report itself, our security team asked for a few targeted artifacts to satisfy control evidence in our SIG questionnaire:

- KMS key rotation log (last 12 months) or a signed manifest showing rotation dates and operator IDs
- Public HSM certificate thumbprint and keystore rotation dates
- Privileged access review export (accounts reviewed, reviewer, timestamp) for the audit window
- Sample SAML assertion logs for federated user activity (one week sample)

Can you confirm if those can be provided and whether you can redact service account names? We also prefer a bridge letter confirming coverage if your Type II period doesn't perfectly align.

Thanks,
Emma
ArborPay — Sr. InfoSec Analyst
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@arborpay.com>
Cc: Mike Davenport <mike.davenport@arborpay.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts for our audit

Emma —

Thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter, and we can extract scoped artifacts for the items you listed. Quick clarifications so we scope correctly:

1) Audit period: our 2026 Type II covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Is that the window you need covered? If you need a different range we can produce a signed bridge letter to explain overlap/gap.

2) KMS rotation manifest: we can provide an operator-id + key-id + rotation-timestamp CSV (we can redact full operator email if preferred and replace with role). Confirm whether you need the last 12 months or the full SOC period.

3) HSM public cert thumbprint: we will include the certificate chain and thumbprint. For any key material we will only share metadata (no private keys).

4) Privileged access review: we can provide an export with reviewer, role reviewed, review timestamp, and high-level outcome. We will redact usernames per your request and substitute anonymized ids (e.g., EMP-###) unless you require exact names for audit reconciliation.

5) SAML assertions: we can provide a week-long sample (UTC 2026-08-02 — 2026-08-08) with PII redacted; note this is large so we'll provide as a password-protected archive via secure upload.

Attached: redwood_soc2_typeii_2026.pdf (the report) and a draft bridge letter (redwood_bridge_letter_202611.pdf).

Upload instructions: we will place supplemental artifacts on a presigned upload link; please confirm a point of contact for access if you prefer an Airlock transfer or secure SharePoint.

If that scope sounds right I will loop in our security ops team (Karthik and Laura) to generate the artifacts and send you the secure bundle.

Best,
Markus Klein
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
